mean, median, min, max


```{r}
    billboard_data |> 
summarize(mean_wh_salaries = mean(salary),
            median_wh_salaries = median(salary),
)

```

```{r}
billboard_data |> 
  summarize(mean_wh_salaries = mean(salary),
            median_wh_salaries = median(salary),
  max_wh_salaries = max(salary),
            min_wh_salaries = min(salary)
)
```
